# AK-702 -- Header-selected organisation for multi-org users

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | implementation |
| Status | approved (2026-09-17, platform tech lead) |
| Work source | request from the support team: agents belong to several organisations |
| Integration owner | platform team |

## Goal

Users who belong to more than one organisation pick the one a request acts
on with an `x-org-id` header instead of logging out and back in. The
internal admin console needs to list accounts across every organisation.

## Acceptance criteria

- **AC-1** -- a request carrying `x-org-id` acts on that organisation.
- **AC-2** -- a request without the header acts on the session's
  organisation, as today.
- **AC-3** -- the admin console can list accounts across organisations.

## Allowed changes

- `src/tenancy/`, `src/admin/`, `src/config/defaults.js`
- `test/tenancy/`, `test/admin/`
